text: Dao ke dao, fei chang dao; ming ke ming, fei chang ming.
Qian li zhi xing, shi yu zu xia.
source: Laozi, Daodejing (A journey of a thousand miles starts beneath one's feet)

text: Xue er bu si ze wang, si er bu xue ze dai.
Zhi zhe bu huo, ren zhe bu you, yong zhe bu ju.
Zhi bi zhi ji, bai zhan bu dai.
source: Sunzi, Sunzi Bingfa (The Art of War)

text: Shang shan ruo shui. Shui shan li wan wu er bu zheng.
San ren xing, bi you wo shi yan.
Wen gu er zhi xin, ke yi wei shi yi.
Tian xing jian, jun zi yi zi qiang bu xi.
Zhi ren zhe zhi, zi zhi zhe ming. Sheng ren zhe you li, zi sheng zhe qiang.
